candidate: V4: exact cost-budget DP plus mapped hasEdge membership fix

protocol.measurement: Native ARM64, isolated release subprocesses, serial AB/BA pairs; one excluded warmup pair and nine measured pairs; microbench calibration targets 0.7 seconds for the faster binary.
protocol.reported_reduction: 100 * (1 - median(candidate_time / baseline_time) across pairs); not the ratio of marginal medians.
protocol.interval: Deterministic 10,000-resample bootstrap interval for the median paired ratio; descriptive evidence from this host/workload.
protocol.paired_batch_caution: Absolute timings differ across separately run batches; do not subtract their marginal medians to infer the independent hasEdge benefit.
protocol.cache: Covered10k uses a fresh compatible prepared catalog for each source variant; catalog preparation is excluded from timed runs. Dense32 is uncached.
protocol.process_scope: End-to-end wall/user/system/RSS measurements cover the full ExpansionHunter subprocess, including startup, cache loading when enabled, read processing, alignment, genotyping and output writing. Fixture/cache preparation and post-run output comparison are excluded.
protocol.output_policy: VCF and JSON exact bytes. BAM complete header and complete record-byte multiset, including duplicates; only record order may differ.
protocol.fair_control: Published SIMD with precisely the same mapped hasEdge fix; DP algorithm is the remaining production-code difference.

input_manifest.scope: Synthetic, independent loci and distinct deterministic flanks; not a WGS performance claim
input_manifest.pair_layout: Forward-strand aligned SAM SEQ for both records; flags99/147; right mate covers repeat; left mate covers flank

graph_membership_attribution.scope: Streaming covered10k, fixed DP implementation, only reviewed mapped hasEdge membership change; same 7 compute and 1 preprocessing worker, cached, HTS decode/encode0, one excluded warmup and nine AB/BA measured pairs.

edge_on_budget.schema_id_explanation: Source fingerprint used for cache compatibility; independent matching prepared cache supplied for each binary. Optimization, code-generation and all other flags identical.

edge_on_simd.schema_id_explanation: Source fingerprint used for cache compatibility; independent matching prepared cache supplied for each binary. Optimization, code-generation and all other flags identical.

graph_membership_attribution.causal_scope: Effect of the complete hasEdge replacement, including owner/iterator copies, checked-array/direct-pointer traversal and count-to-find early exit; not an isolated measurement of atomic stalls.

dense32_end_to_end.scope: Repository synthetic example; repeated identical-coordinate loci, not WGS
dense32_end_to_end.identity_policy: VCF, JSON and compressed BAM byte-for-byte, including BAM order

actual_input_internal_audit.scope: Complete input context, best score, ordered raw CIGAR operations and ordered public Path/Alignment output. The unused secondBestScore local is excluded and recorded independently. This audit uses the final DP header before the membership-only graph fix.

scope_limits: Synthetic workload is not a whole-genome clinical benchmark.
Native Intel/AMD AVX2 timing is not included; translated x86 runs are correctness evidence only.
Mixed repeat250 and short-target150 have measured time regressions; repeat250 and both dense32 modes fail their local RSS no-growth gates.
Sparse and dense retained buffers can coexist; fewer visited states do not establish a worst-case memory reduction.
Full-matrix values and the unused local secondBestScore are not the output contract of the pinned wrapper.
One pre-existing application unit test remains failing; the whole application is not claimed sanitizer-clean.
evidence_paths: Paths refer to the budget-DP evidence bundle root; command lines and raw canonical streams are omitted from this compact summary.
